opening.speech: You can look at the door if you like. Everyone else has. Off its hinges, from the outside, by somebody who knew the bar was on the left.

inside.speech: Sleeping in it, as I do in the smoking weeks. I heard the boat before I heard them — she came in low and quiet and she did not scrape, which means somebody aboard knew this shore. That is the part they do not like.

believe.speech: Because if I saw a boat come in clean then somebody stood on this shore and waved it, and everybody in Salt Wick would rather it was strangers and bad luck. Bad luck costs nobody a cousin.

local.speech: Or somebody who was told. I have stopped saying which by name. Take it up the hill — Nesh Cairnhead was awake that night whatever else she was, and she has never once said a thing to be liked.
